email_body:
Hi Eric,

I saw ENTech's n8n-nodes-netsuite-rest package, which connects n8n to NetSuite's SuiteTalk REST API. Clients who already sync NetSuite with Salesforce, HubSpot or Shopify often still chase unpaid invoices manually.

I build OpenClaw-based AI agents that read open invoices from NetSuite, send reminders on overdue balances, check that invoices synced correctly across systems and send a weekly AR report.

Would agents like this fit any of your current integration projects?

Best,
